findings.F1: In the choppy bars (the regime 'unknown', 17.1 % of all bars in folds B and C), the 10-day excess return after drift falls further the deeper the close sits below its 20-day average in units of its 20-day swing: −7.08 % (t −2.88, 24 grid cases) for a stretch below −2, −3.12 % (t −0.94, 19 cases) for −2 to −1, and −3.49 % (t −1.11, 27 cases) for −1 to 0. Above the average there is no matching carry: +2.22 % (t 0.66) for 0 to 1, −1.07 % for 1 to 2, and +0.58 % (t 0.19) above 2. The carry shows on the short side only, and step 5's slope over all folds was flat (t 0.18, 200 cases).
findings.F2: In the choppy bars, the coin's 20-day return in units of its swing grades the next 10 days more cleanly than the stretch does. The 10-day excess is −7.55 % (t −2.46, 18 cases) for a scaled 20-day return below −1, −5.39 % (t −2.97, 34 cases; day-clustered t −2.93 on the 5 agitated cases that could be classed) for −1 to −0.3, +0.11 % for −0.3 to +0.3, and +2.00 % for +0.3 to +1. Over all choppy grid cases its correlation with the 10-day excess is 0.21 (stretch: 0.20).
findings.F3: The choppy fall carry is concentrated where the coin swings most. The coin's highest 20-day swing tercile shows a 10-day excess of −6.90 % (t −2.68, 22 cases). The middle tercile shows −1.96 % (t −0.70, 34 cases) and the lowest −0.83 % (t −0.48, 70 cases). Choppy agitated short is the one empty cell of the profile map.
findings.F4: Outside the choppy profile, a close more than 2 swings above its 20-day average is followed by a 10-day excess of +5.34 % (t 3.01, 126 cases). This holds in rising markets (+8.60 %, day-clustered t 1.92, 22 days) and falling ones (+8.75 %, t 1.52). It is an upside continuation in trending markets, which the map already holds (034-01.e1, 034-02, 033-03.b2), so it is not a discovery.
findings.F5: Outside the choppy profile, a daily fall of more than 2 swings is followed by a next-day excess of +1.41 % (t 3.11, 189 days), and a rise of 0 to 1 swing by −0.34 % (t −3.28, 2,196 days). This is the next-day reversal the map already holds in falling agitated markets (038-01, 047-01, 058-02.b1.g1.b1.b1).
findings.F6: The weekday pattern is not strong enough to count. Next-day excess returns on Fridays (+0.47 %) and Saturdays (+0.39 %) have day-clustered t of only 1.50 and 1.54 (about 207 days each), and the late-week gain is already held (045-01).
findings.F7: The book lost in 8 of 12 windows (mean daily returns −0.0009 to +0.0016) while holding the coins rose in 7. This fits F1: the short forecast was active on every choppy close below the average, most of whose cases (the shallow ones) carry no fall after drift.

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, the more a coin's 20-day return has fallen, counted in units of its current 20-day standard deviation of daily returns, the more it keeps falling over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a range-bound coin that is swinging more than usual should short in proportion to its recent fall measured in its own daily moves, and stay flat on calm or rising stretches.
ideas.name: choppy agitated fall carries
